issue.title: predict_ovo wrongly calculates scores for tie-break
issue.body:
SVC's and LinearSVC's (I didn't check other classifiers) decision_function in binary classification case returns values lower than 0 when predict returns 0, and >0 when predict returns 1. 
So this part of code is wrong:

pred = estimators[k].predict(X)
score = _predict_binary(estimators[k], X)
scores[:, i] += score
scores[:, j] -= score
votes[pred == 0, i] += 1
votes[pred == 1, j] += 1

In SVM case we should substract score from scores[:,i] and add to scores[:,j]

body:
After making this change, two tests fail - test_ovo_ties and test_ovo_ties2. I assume it is OK to rewrite those tests so that things pass again - since we are changing the behavior in the case of a tie? 

CC @ogrisel @arjoly

Can you make a pull request with the proposed fix? 
It would be easier to help you.
